command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,datetime
out=Path('.cache/pr12-rc8/q4_native_audit/output')
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
p=Path('.cache/pr12-rc8/q4_native_audit/input_bundle.json')
b=json.loads(p.read_text())
rows=[]
for name,want in b['files'].items():
 x=Path(name).read_bytes(); got=hashlib.sha256(x).hexdigest()
 rows.append({'path':name,'expected_sha256':want,'actual_sha256':got,'bytes':len(x),'matches':got==want,'read_type':'hash_only'})
record={'checked_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'bundle_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'files':rows}
(out/'subject_hashes_before.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))
assert len(rows)==22 and all(r['matches'] for r in rows)
PY
